summary: Mizuho Financial Group filed a Form 6-K reporting monthly progress on its share repurchase program. In August 2026, the company repurchased 9,078,600 shares for ¥75,678,470,200 via trust-market purchases. The board-authorized program, set May 15 and July 30, 2026, permits up to 35 million shares (1.4% outstanding) and ¥200 billion through September 30, 2026; cumulative repurchases were 18,226,400 shares for ¥147,065,069,600 as of August 31. No premium, price terms, or advisors disclosed. This routine buyback progress report signals ongoing capital return; watch monthly updates for completion relative to authority limits.
